That works well. I added the note, saved, and it shows up right there on the card in its own little highlighted block, separate from the description that came from the page. I can tell at a glance it's my own thought and not something pulled off the site. Having it on the card is useful, not cluttered — it's tucked below and clearly set apart, so it doesn't fight with the title or description.

One thing I'd want as we build this for real: my notes won't always be a single sentence. Sometimes I'll want a couple of bullet points, or to bold a word, or drop in a link. So I'd expect to be able to write a note with a bit of light formatting and have it actually show up formatted on the card — bullets as bullets, bold as bold — rather than showing the raw symbols. This one sentence looks perfect; I just want to make sure the note can grow into something slightly richer than plain text.

Otherwise, yes — this matches how I'd expect a personal note to work.
